title: 第一卷 第22章 以后只寻花问柳，再不仗势欺人
content_zh:
刚被扶起来的黄刚，眼见秦绝一拳轰杀了护卫，吓得腿脚一软，一屁股又摔在了地上。

    他脸色煞白，目中瞪着惊恐道：“你敢伤我，还……还敢杀我的人！”

    秦绝瞥了一眼黄刚，冷声道：“我还敢杀了你，你信是不信？”

    黄刚喉咙一滚，秦绝眼里的杀气，让他有种感觉，眼前这个人不是在开玩笑，是真的敢杀他！

    “韩汐是我的人，你若还敢纠缠她，下次你必死无疑！还有今日这事，也没这么容易过去，回去告诉你爷爷，让他一个时辰之内，带上你一起到秦府赔罪。如果你们不来，等我亲自上门，就算是城主出面，也保不住你。”秦绝冷然道。

    黄刚气得咬牙切齿！

    明明他才是被打伤的人啊！怎么还要他赔罪？还讲不讲道理了！

    “好！我回去之后，一定会一五一十的告诉我爷爷！”黄刚咬牙道。

    等他回去了，非得让他爷爷出手，杀了眼前这个王八蛋不可！

    “带他滚吧！我饭菜都凉了。”秦绝哼声道。

    搀扶着黄刚的护卫，心里也是骇得发抖，他和死去的那个护卫修为一样，都是九品巅峰。

    能一拳打死九品巅峰的人，可不是他能招惹的。

    所以护卫连一句狠话都没敢放，一把将黄刚扛起来就跑了。

    “你个傻批，本少伤的是肩，又不是腿，你丫的快把本少放下来！本少丢不起这人……”

    “噗——”韩汐听着酒楼外面黄刚那气急败坏的叫骂声，忍不住笑出了声。

    刚才她其实还是有些害怕的，害怕秦绝会直接杀了黄刚。

    所幸，秦绝还是留了余地。

    秦绝轻笑道：“你笑起来很好看，以后要多笑笑。”

    韩汐意识到自己有些失态了，但被秦绝这般夸着，她心里却是欢喜的很。

    但很快，她心里又是忧虑了起来。

    “少爷，整个凤州城里，就只有黄老爷子能够炼制武灵丹，少爷日后若想冲击灵境，说不得还要请黄老爷子帮忙，但今日这事一出，以后想请黄老帮忙，恐怕就会有一些难度了。都是汐儿不好，连累了少爷。”

    韩汐有些自责。

    虽然出手的人是秦绝，但黄刚也是因为纠缠她，这才找上来的。

    秦绝笑道：“无妨，凤州城就他一个，但别的地方，比黄秋云厉害的炼丹师多的是。”

    武灵丹，是一种可以帮助武者，提升冲击灵境成功率的丹药。
content_en:
Huang Gang, who had just been helped up, saw Qin Jue kill the guard with one punch. He was so frightened that his legs went weak and he fell to the ground again.

    His face turned pale, and his eyes were filled with horror as he said, "You dare to hurt me, and... you dare to kill my people!"

    Qin Jue glanced at Huang Gang and said coldly: "I dare to kill you, do you believe it or not?"

    Huang Gang's throat rolled, and the murderous look in Qin Jue's eyes made him feel that the person in front of him was not joking, he really dared to kill him!

    "Han tide is mine. If you dare to pester her, you will die next time! Today's incident will not be easy to pass. Go back and tell your grandfather and ask him to take you to the Qin Mansion within an hour to make amends. If you don't come, wait until I come to the door in person, even if the city lord comes forward, he can't save you." Qin Jue said coldly.

    Huang Gang was so angry that he gritted his teeth!

    He was obviously the one who was injured! Why should he apologize? It’s not reasonable anymore!

    "Okay! After I go back, I will tell my grandpa everything!" Huang Gang gritted his teeth.

    When he goes back, his grandfather must take action and kill the bastard in front of him!

    "Take him away! My food is cold." Qin Jue snorted.

    The guard who supported Huang Gang was trembling with fear. He had the same cultivation level as the dead guard, at the peak of the ninth level.

    He was not someone he could mess with who could kill someone at the peak of the ninth level with one punch.

    So the guard didn't even dare to say a harsh word, he picked Huang Gang up and ran away.

    "You idiot, I hurt my shoulder, not my leg. Please put me down quickly! I can't afford to lose this person..."

    "Pfft..." Han tide couldn't help but laugh when he heard Huang Gang's angry yelling outside the restaurant.

    She was actually a little scared just now, afraid that Qin Jue would directly kill Huang Gang.

    Fortunately, Qin Jue still left some room.

    Qin Jue chuckled and said, "You look good when you smile. Smile more in the future."

    Han tide realized that she had lost her composure, but she was very happy to be praised by Qin Jue like this.

    But soon, she became worried again.

    "Master, in the entire Fengzhou City, only Mr. Huang can refine martial spirit pills. If the young master wants to reach the spiritual realm in the future, he may have to ask Mr. Huang for help. But after today's incident, it will be difficult to ask Mr. Huang for help in the future. It's all because of Xi'er's fault, which has hurt the young master."

    Han tide felt a little guilty.

    Although Qin Jue was the one who took action, Huang Gang came to her because he was pestering her.

    Qin Jue said with a smile: "It doesn't matter, he is the only one in Fengzhou City, but there are many more powerful alchemists than Huang Qiuyun in other places."

    Martial Spirit Pill is a pill that can help warriors increase their success rate in attacking the spiritual realm.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 22 From now on, I will only look for flowers and willows, and will never bully others.
